program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((pair-start (- c (remainder c 2)))
                           (offset (remainder c 2))
                           (old-pair (- (- w 2) pair-start))
                           (old-c (+ old-pair offset)))
                      (at g r old-c))))))
